text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove overworking herself and losing 
her way? 
I can't even imagine such a thing...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do you two have a moment? 
The menu is finished, so I'd like to share 
it with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've assigned numbers to each item on the 
menu, 
so let's use those numbers when taking 
orders.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... This makes them easy to remember 
and simplifies filling out order slips. 
Thank you, Sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Just as I thought, she hasn't lost her 
way at all. 
Flawless as always——...Wait?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Um, Air Groove? 
Looking at the drink menu numbers... 
number 6 is missing, and there are two 
number 5s.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whoops——excuse me, a typo. Thanks, Alve. 
Now, I'll go check on the kitchen crew 
while fixing this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove just now... Something felt a 
little off.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(A typo is a trivial thing. A careless 
mistake anyone could make. 
Still... for someone like her, it really 
is... a bit strange.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(She's backed others up countless times, 
but for me to cover for her... that almost 
never happened.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(If anything, all this time... she was the 
one giving so much...——)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Something's still missing 
here......

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alve's fans are captivated by her prodigy 
persona. 
Dura's fans expect her to embody the 
concept of "the strongest"...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then having both play high-ranking demons 
is indeed best. 
If we frame the customers as "newbie 
demons," perhaps...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(She's working this late into the 
night......)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......We really shouldn't just keep 
leaning on her like this, should we?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sis Groove... working that hard...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it, it's only 
natural. No matter how infallible someone 
seems... 
Taking care of every single student on top 
of us... of course her hands are full.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I never even considered it. 
Ever since I first met Sis Groove, she's 
been so capable... such a magnificent 
person.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You've been with her since your days in 
junior academy, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes. She always looked out for me——

text_block_list.name: Young Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Feeling nervous? Then start by taking a 
deep breath. 
Breathe in, breathe out... Good. Well 
done, Dura."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Because I'd put too much pressure on 
myself, I'd get anxious easily. 
Sis Groove was the first one to notice and 
reach out to me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even after entering the academy, she 
looked after me at every turn... 
When I got injured, she talked through so 
many things with me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
She stayed by my side during rehab, 
working tirelessly... 
And when anxiety and impatience gnawed at 
me, she stayed close and gave me stern 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to feel anxious, and it's 
natural to feel rushed. Acknowledge those 
feelings, 
because overcoming them is what true 
strength is all about.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Duramente... You are strong. Stronger 
than anyone. I give you my word. 
If it's you, you can overcome this——"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Those words... and the knowledge she 
imparted to me... 
Perhaps they were only possible because 
Sis Groove herself had struggled through 
the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
She has given me so much... so very much. 
That is why I can run toward becoming the 
'strongest' today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right. 
Perhaps I... have been given so much as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"We're hosting a flowing somen gathering 
at my mother's academy. 
Our policy is to cherish seasonal events. 
You're coming too, Alve!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
She'd fuss over me without being asked, 
pulling me into her circle. 
Back then, I thought she was simply 
overbearing, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Academy seasonal events, discussion 
panels... 
She dragged me along by the hand, teaching 
me all kinds of things...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It felt like being tossed into a lukewarm 
bath... an itchy, restless feeling. 
Yet strangely enough, it never felt 
unpleasant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I built 'myself' with my own hands. I 
still believe 
what I've constructed is flawless. But——

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If there was one last missing piece to 
complete me—— 
The one who filled it was surely... her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All this time, I was only on the 
receiving end. 
That's precisely why... we shouldn't just 
keep relying on her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If she's struggling, then I... need to 
support her. 
Because this is *our* booth, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......At any rate, we need to devise a 
plan.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
With you supporting us, Alve-senpai, it'll 
be worth a hundred of us.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You observe Sis Groove closely and 
understand her so well. 
There must be so much only you can do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
——... 
In terms of time spent watching her, 
wouldn't you have more seniority?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I was just thinking I'd like to 
put that to good use here. 
So... Alve-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let us come up with the "strongest" plan 
together!
